info.title: VionX API
info.description: Single entry point for the VionX Android app and admin SPA (Supabase Edge Function `api`).

bearerAuth.description: Parent: Supabase Auth access token (phone OTP or Google).

childSession.name: x-vionx-child-session
childSession.description: Child: opaque session token from POST /v1/auth/child/login.

pendingAccountDeletion.description: Set while this account’s deletion request is in its grace period (DELETION_GRACE_DAYS, 14 days): the app then shows only the Privacy Center, where the request can be cancelled.

coreServiceConsent.description: CORE_SERVICE consent is in force (granted on an accepted policy version). Without it the child cannot sign in.

crossBorderTransferConsent.description: CROSS_BORDER_TRANSFER consent is in force. Required with CORE_SERVICE before the child can sign in.

deletionScheduledFor.description: Deletion requested: the login is off and the profile is purged at this time.

pin.description: Shown once on the credential card; never stored in clear.
Omit to let the server generate a 6-digit PIN.
Omit to generate a new 6-digit PIN.

revokeSessions.description: Also sign the child out everywhere.

disabled.description: Default true. false re-enables the child login.

acceptances.description: The signed-in parent’s acceptances; null without a parent token.

needsAcceptance.description: True when the parent must accept the current versions.

deviceId.description: Stored only as a sha-256 hash.

childAssentRequiredNow.description: A grant made now would need the child’s assent (age ≥ 7).

missingPrerequisite.description: With reason PREREQUISITE_MISSING: the consent this one depends on (AI_PERSONALIZATION needs CROSS_BORDER_TRANSFER).

policyVersion.description: The PRIVACY_POLICY version the parent was shown; must be the current one.

deviceId.description: Stored only as a sha-256 hash.
Stored only as a sha-256 hash.

downloadUrl.description: Signed URL to the zip, valid until expiresAt (24 h after completion).

cancelledAt.description: Set when the parent cancelled the request during the grace period (14 days).

items.description: Non-archived items on this skill (SKILL only).

post.summary: Child sign-in with login id + PIN
post.description: Returns an opaque session token (30-day sliding expiry). 5 wrong PINs lock the login for 15 minutes; attempts are rate-limited per device and per login id. A correct PIN without CORE_SERVICE and CROSS_BORDER_TRANSFER consent in force answers 403 CONSENT_REQUIRED (`details.consentType` names the missing one).

post.summary: Grant a consent for a child
post.description: Recorded against the current PRIVACY_POLICY version (409 if `policyVersion` is not current). Idempotent for the same version; a grant on a newer version supersedes the old record. AI, microphone and health grants for a child aged 7+ wait for the child’s assent. CROSS_BORDER_TRANSFER is its own explicit grant (never implied by accepting the policy); AI_PERSONALIZATION needs it in force first (403 CONSENT_REQUIRED, `details.consentType` CROSS_BORDER_TRANSFER). Audited; emits `consent.granted`.

post.description: The child login is turned off and every session revoked at once; the profile is hard-deleted after the 14-day grace period, during which the parent can cancel (ledgers anonymised). Idempotent. Audited.

post.summary: Delete the parent account and household data
post.description: Owner: the household is hidden, every child login turned off and the parent signed out everywhere at once; until the purge the parent can still sign in, but every route except this one, its cancel, `GET /v1/me`, `GET /v1/policies/current` and `GET /v1/privacy/overview` answers 403 ACCOUNT_DISABLED (`details.reason` DELETION_PENDING). Everything is hard-deleted after the 14-day grace period (ledgers anonymised). Reachable in the app and from the public web page. Idempotent. Audited.

During the 14-day grace period: the job becomes CANCELLED (the purge skips it) and the child can sign in again (unless the parent had disabled the child before the request; sessions revoked by the request stay revoked). 404 when there is no pending deletion (including after the purge) or for another household’s child; 409 once the purge is due. Audited; emits `privacy.deletion_cancelled`.

post.description: During the 14-day grace period: the job becomes CANCELLED (the purge skips it), the account works again, the household is visible again and its children can sign in (except those disabled before the request or with their own pending deletion). 404 when there is no pending account deletion; 409 once the purge is due. Audited; emits `privacy.deletion_cancelled`.

post.summary: Import a library package (zip): dry-run diff or apply
post.description: CONTENT_ADMIN. Body: the package zip (`library/<version>/<grade>-<subject>/`). Validates schema, checksums and the library rules, then diffs against the library. `mode=apply` writes everything in one transaction; re-importing the same package is a no-op. Entities the package no longer lists are archived, never deleted. An invalid package answers 422 PACKAGE_INVALID with `details.errors`.
